scope: two single-host cold Qwen2.5-0.5B responses; same model fingerprint and 39-input/1-output-token workload; client, inference and preparation use distinct local processes
limitations: Cold bundle bytes are identical; the saved counted bodies are unused offline correction rows, not an improvement to online bytes.
One response per policy; warm multi-response throughput, variable prompts, full wire bytes, and persistent storage need separate measurements.
The policies shift preparation between startup and run windows; their run-window latencies cannot be ranked alone, and this cohort is too small for a latency claim.
